_meta.description: Falconer subclass passives: 3 stat-based (max 20 levels each). Focus: double attack (falcon), bleed/DoT, evasion.

subclass_passives.description_fr: +0.8% chance de double attaque et +0.5% ATK par niveau. Deux corps, une seule décision.
subclass_passives.description_en: +0.8% double attack chance and +0.5% ATK per level. Two bodies, one decision.

subclass_passives.description_fr: +1.2% dégâts infligés et +0.5 chance d'effet par niveau. Ce que la flèche manque, les serres le trouvent.
subclass_passives.description_en: +1.2% damage dealt and +0.5 effect chance per level. What the arrow misses, the talons find.

subclass_passives.description_fr: +1 esquive et +0.4% dégâts infligés par niveau. On apprend beaucoup à regarder voler plus haut que soi.
subclass_passives.description_en: +1 evasion and +0.4% damage dealt per level. There is much to learn from watching something fly higher than you.
